q: What is the key difference between a chatbot and an autonomous agent?
options: Agents plan, call tools, observe and loop until a goal is done, while chatbots answer and stop
Chatbots can call tools but choose not to
Agents cannot send messages to messaging platforms
explanation: Chatbots answer and stop. Autonomous agents plan, call tools, observe the results and keep looping until the goal is complete.
Claude Code is made by Anthropic. OpenAI makes the Codex CLI, and Nous Research makes Hermes Agent.

q: How can you bring an existing Claude Code or OpenAI Codex setup into Hermes?
options: You cannot; you must start over from scratch
By copying files manually into the terminal
Using Hermes's 'Import from Other Agents' feature
explanation: Hermes has an 'Import from Other Agents' feature that can import a Claude Code (~/.claude) or OpenAI Codex CLI (~/.codex) setup. There is also an official 'Migrate from OpenClaw' guide.

q: Which of these is NOT a feature of Hermes Agent?
options: Being closed-source and locked to a single model
explanation: Hermes is open-source, works with many LLM providers and backends, and is not locked to a single model. Persistent memory, agent-created skills and the messaging gateway are all real features.
